newsitem.title: USA: Perry says no evidence Pyongyang holding U.S. POWs.
newsitem.headline: Perry says no evidence Pyongyang holding U.S. POWs.

text.p: Defence Secretary William Perry said on Wednesday that U.S. investigators have found no evidence North Korea is still holding American prisoners from the 1950s Korean War.

"We have been investigating for years whether there might be any living American POWs (prisoners of war) in North Korea. We have no evidence to support that," Perry told the Senate Armed Services Committee.
He said American deserters from the Korean War still live in North Korea, "but in spite of years of investigation ... we have found no evidence of living American POWS in North Korea."

Perry was asked about that possibility because of testimony and documents released at a House of Representatives hearing on Tuesday showing that more than 900 U.S. prisoners of war might have been left behind when an armistice was signed on July 27, 1953, and all prisoners were supposed to have been exchanged.
